briefHtml:
Portfolio Brief — Fri 2026-10-09 (SGT)

  • NAV S$10,264,048 (−0.49% reported; ≈ +0.01% real vs restated base — flat). Listed sleeve −2.72%, biggest real drop of the week. Restatement night 11: Oct 8 revised to S$10,262,598 (−S$24,727).
  • Biggest mover: global rout — STI −3.5% bank-led (DBS −4.7% to 73.85), SMIC −6.73% to 56.80, HSI −1.43% on mainland sell-the-news; oil spiked +3.4–3.8% (Brent ~$104) on physical Gulf disruption. Miners hedged: GDX +1.47%, SILJ +1.56%, SLVP +1.33%.
  • One thing: the two hedges whipsawed — Trump took pre-midterm Iran strikes off the table yet oil surged anyway (Abqaiq fires on satellite, Hormuz mines, tanker hit off Qatar); the AI trade cracked on the FT OpenAI revenue-gap report before CNBC’s methodology clarification, and a Samsung miss dumped memory (DRAM ETF −5%).

State

  • 2 critical flags — one REAL, one STALE. SMIC −6.3% flag vs actual −6.73%: REAL (first true positive of the week). Xiaomi −6.3% flag vs actual −1.17%: FALSE as day move (stale ~25.25 baseline) — but 23.66 is a 3-month low with top-10 short selling and southbound net sell, so the level signal is real.
  • L46.SI Yahoo 404, 21st session. FX: USDSGD 1.2807 (SGD softer 3rd day), USDCNY ≈6.694, USDHKD ≈7.847.

Overnight (Thu Oct 8 closes)

  • SGX rout: STI −3.5% (−195.48) to 5,412.96, banks led. DBS −4.7% to 73.85. Keppel −4.81%, STE −4.71%. CDL 7.10 −0.98% (held 7.00), UOL −0.25%.
  • HK sell-the-news: HSI 23,786 −1.43% (lost 24,000), HS Tech −2.89%. Tencent −2.2% ≈ 411. SMIC 56.80 −6.73%. Xiaomi 23.66 −1.17% (3-month low). Divergence: southbound net BOUGHT HK$6.477bn, Tencent topped buys.
  • US: SPX 7,765.36 −0.47%, Nasdaq −1.25%, Dow +0.10%, VIX 15.74 +4.4%. 10y 5.23% (−6bp) after a strong $22bn 30y auction. Equal-weight SPX gained — rotation, not risk-off. NVDA −3% (OpenAI report); memory dumped on Samsung miss.
  • Metals/oil: gold +0.4% ~$4,158; silver $59.25 (held $59–60; ratio 69.8). GDX 86.72 +1.47%, SILJ 26.68 +1.56%, SLVP 34.26 +1.33%. WTI +3.3% ~$91.2, Brent +3.8% ~$104.

Insider / Congress

  • Wing Tai: Oct 6 filings (Change in Interests of Director + Grant of Share Awards) remain latest; today’s Oct 8–9 sweep limited by source availability; nothing found for other held names. IR page
  • Congress: no new filings Oct 8–9. In window: PA Senate Dem 2x Dell bond buys (Oct 7); Doggett HD/IBM/JNJ/PPG dividend reinvests (Oct 6); Fong T-bill $15–50K (Oct 6); OH-6 GS buy / MSFT,WFC sells; CA-11 REOF $500K–1M. Unusual Whales

Policy watch

  • Iran whipsaw: Trump — no attack before midterms, productive talks; Araghchi to respond in days. Ground truth worsening: Abqaiq fires, Tanjib gas plant fire, Houthi missile at Riyadh airport, tanker struck off Qatar, Hormuz mines, ~20M bbl stranded, new US vessel sanctions. Newsquawk
  • Fed hawks: Waller — more hikes likely needed (AI + energy shock = persistent inflation); Musalem — rates ought to rise in 6–9 months. Claims 197K. Treasury buyback $6bn of $14.89bn offered; strong 30y auction → 10y 5.23%.
  • AI crack: FT — OpenAI ~$50bn annualized vs ~$70bn signaled; CNBC — methodology difference. AVGO arranging $50bn+ OpenAI chip financing (WSJ); Solidigm ~$10bn IPO; Firmus Grid closed books early on valuation wariness.
  • EU-China: Sefcovic met Wang in Beijing; EU weighs hybrid-car safeguards; Beijing threatens rare-earth leverage. Greer: US has a stable situation with China. PBoC: no intent to devalue CNY.
  • ECB minutes dovish read: orderly long-end repricing supported the stance — dampens further-hike expectations. Lagarde: no broadening of price pressures. French unions call Oct 13 strike.
  • Ukraine: strikes on Omsk + Bashkortostan refineries + Salavat; Rubio — war at stalemate; Witkoff/Kushner meet Ukrainians in Miami Friday.

Risk

  • Oil-driven inflation re-acceleration is the compounding risk: Brent ~$104 on physical damage feeds the hawkish chorus and Dec-hike pricing — the same force derating SG banks/REITs (DBS −4.7%, 2-day derating running).
  • HK divergence: mainland sold the reopen but southbound net-bought HK$6.48bn — decides the next leg for ~4% of NW. Listed book −2.72%, biggest real drop of the week.
  • Silver line: 1,777 oz × $59.25 ≈ S$134.8k vs S$56.24k loan → equity ≈ S$78.6k ≈ 1.72x; −4% silver day ≈ −6.9% equity.
  • FX ~35% non-SGD; USDSGD 1.2807 softer 3rd day (mild tailwind). Concentration: SG property/bank + HK tech clusters fell together — more correlated in a rates-shock tape than the barbell assumes.

Alpha (signals, not advice)

  • HK barbell post-verdict: southbound bid (HK$6.477bn, Tencent top) vs price — stabilization above ~410 on persisting southbound bid re-arms the Tencent add; Xiaomi 3-month low + top-10 short = patience leg.
  • Memory-cycle crack = Xiaomi BOM relief: Samsung miss dumped memory (DRAM −5%, Besi −14% wk); market prices demand problem first, cost relief later. Solidigm IPO pricing = memory sentiment gauge.
  • Energy security/defense leg: oil +3.4% on physical disruption with strikes off the table; buyback + strong 30y auction eased 10y to 5.23% — follow-through sub-5.20% arms the rally-and-hold duration sleeve.

trumpWatch.title: Iran whipsaw: Trump rules out pre-midterm strike; ground truth worsens
trumpWatch.detail: Trump: productive discussions, no attack before the midterms; Araghchi says Iran responds to the US proposal within days; Rubio: southern Hormuz corridor ~80% of pre-conflict levels. But: Abqaiq fires visible on satellite (Oct 8), Tanjib gas-plant fire, Houthi ballistic missile at Riyadh airport, tanker struck off Qatar (first deep-Gulf attack in ~a month, casualties), Hormuz mine explosions, Treasury says ~20M bbl stranded and Iran stopped loading/offloading crude, new US sanctions on Iran-linked vessels. Oil spiked: WTI +3.3% ~$91.2, Brent +3.8% ~$104.

trumpWatch.title: Fed hawks: Waller says more hikes likely needed; Musalem points up in 6–9 months
trumpWatch.detail: Waller (voter): more hikes likely needed, not necessarily consecutive; AI investment plus energy shock are persistent inflationary forces. Musalem: rates ought to be going up in the next six to nine months. Bessent: keep an open mind, core inflation approaching target. Jobless claims 197K (below 200K expected). Treasury buyback accepted $6bn of $14.89bn offered (20–30y liquidity support); strong $22bn 30y auction took 10y to 5.23% (−6bp).

trumpWatch.title: AI trade cracks: FT flags ~$20bn OpenAI revenue gap; Samsung miss dumps memory
trumpWatch.detail: FT: OpenAI annualized revenue ~$50bn vs ~$70bn signaled; CNBC later clarified it is an accounting-methodology difference (excludes cloud-partner gross revenue). NVDA −3% (worst Dow). Samsung prelim Q3 miss (OP +783% Y/Y but below lofty expectations) → DRAM ETF −5%, SOXX −3.5%. AVGO arranging $50bn+ financing for OpenAI custom chips (WSJ); Oracle and SpaceX exploring similar vehicles. SK Hynix Solidigm IPO ~$10bn at up to $100bn valuation; NVDA-backed Firmus Grid closed IPO books early on valuation wariness; Besi −14% on the week.

trumpWatch.title: EU-China: Sefcovic meets Wang in Beijing; Beijing threatens rare-earth leverage
trumpWatch.detail: EU weighs hybrid-car safeguards; Beijing threatens retaliation including rare-earth leverage. USTR Greer: the US has a stable situation with China; Vietnam/China/Asia do not agree on excess capacity. PBoC: no intent to devalue the yuan; will report FX operations to the IMF from 2027.

trumpWatch.title: ECB minutes (dovish read): orderly repricing supported the stance
trumpWatch.detail: All backed the 25bp hike to 2.50%; orderly long-end repricing supported the intended stance, dampening further-hike expectations. Lagarde: attentive, no broadening of price pressures. French unions call an Oct 13 strike. Japan 30y JGB auction firm (4.12%, b/c 3.88x); Takaichi: no reflation policy needed, BoJ independent; USD/JPY below 158.

trumpWatch.title: Ukraine: refinery strikes continue; Rubio says war at stalemate
trumpWatch.detail: Ukraine struck the Omsk and Bashkortostan refineries and Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat. Rubio: war at stalemate (Kremlin agrees). Witkoff/Kushner meet Ukrainians in Miami Friday.

opportunities.thesis: Mainland sold the reopen (HS Tech −2.89%, Tencent −2.2% to ≈411) but southbound funds net-bought HK$6.477bn on the return day with Tencent topping the buy list — an accumulation-versus-price divergence. Tencent ≈411 sits below the old 425 add trigger.
opportunities.signal: Southbound bid persisting plus price stabilization above ~410 re-arms the Tencent add. Xiaomi (23.66, 3-month low, top-10 short selling, southbound net sell) stays a patience leg — no averaging into a short-squeeze target.

opportunities.thesis: Samsung’s prelim Q3 miss dumped the whole memory complex (DRAM ETF −5%, Besi −14% on the week, SK Hynix/MU/STX down). The market prices the phone-demand problem first and the BOM cost relief later.
opportunities.signal: When memory spot declines stop being read as demand destruction, Xiaomi enters an accumulation zone. Watch the Solidigm IPO pricing (~$10bn, up to $100bn valuation) as the memory-cycle sentiment gauge.

opportunities.ticker: Energy security / defense leg; duration gate
opportunities.thesis: Oil +3.4% (Brent ~$104) on physical disruption — Abqaiq/Tanjib fires, Hormuz mines, tanker off Qatar — even with pre-midterm strikes off the table. The $6bn Treasury buyback plus a strong $22bn 30y auction eased 10y to 5.23%.
opportunities.signal: Grid/energy-infra and the defense sleeve’s energy leg keep catching the security-premium bid. Duration deployment stays gated on the long end: follow-through sub-5.20% arms the rally-and-hold sleeve.
